notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Dorei Same followers![/h1]
I haven't posted any updates, which honestly is bad of me. But, better late than never.

Dorei Same is a story about Squalus being sold as a slave to a wealthy daughter. One wants to explore her sexuality in secret while the other is confused about what she wants in life at all. The story of the game explores this connection between the two.

I have been focusing on building their characters and relationship lately. In terms of gameplay, there will be some moments of control, choices and exploration, but the game is heavily story-orientated. It features some spicy scenes with probably at least one more to come.

I have admittedly been focused on a different project a lot lately, but I do take days to work on Dorei Same now and then. Still, it should hopefully not take too long before release since the game is not meant to be very long.

[h1]What to do moving forward[/h1]

- Keep working on the different story events
- Implement more art and spicy scene(s)
- Fix potential glitches
